fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The archetype detail page showed Decks and Cards live tables but had no People section, even though `_arch_person_stats` already contains per-person stats for every archetype.

## What changed

- **`decksite/controllers/api.py`**: Extended `people_api()` to accept an `archetypeId` query parameter. When provided, the `WHERE` clause is narrowed to only people who have played a deck belonging to that archetype (or any of its descendants via `archetype_closure`).
- **`decksite/templates/livepeopletable.mustache`** (new): A partial matching the existing `livecardtable` / `livedecktable` pattern. It renders a `persontable` div that the existing `persontable.jsx` picks up; it passes `data-archetype-id` so the JS automatically filters the `/api/people/` call to the current archetype.
- **`decksite/templates/archetype.mustache`**: Added a People section using `{{> livepeopletable}}` directly after the Cards section.

No view or controller logic needed changing because `archetype.id` is already accessible in the template context via the existing `__getattr__` delegation in `views/archetype.py`, and the JS `DataManager` already forwards `archetypeId` to whatever endpoint the table uses.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed on all touched files.
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing skip, unrelated functional test).

Fixes #11219
